content: Preventive vs reactive maintenance: reactive = run-to-failure response to unexpected breakdowns; preventive = scheduled routine upkeep to prevent failures, extend asset life, improve safety. Most orgs blend both: preventive for high-value/critical assets, reactive for non-critical items. FM software table stakes: auto-routing of requests by need/urgency, vendor/technician assignment, escalation of delays, full lifecycle tracking; SLA dashboards covering asset performance, spend, vendor response time, recurring issues, PM completion rate; asset history tied to specific equipment via tagging so every request links to service record for repair-vs-replace decisions.
